g.title: j284107404
g.text: Finally found a use for all those gas cans you keep buying me.

g.title: j3221450540
g.text: I haven't bought you any gas cans.

g.title: j1021901
g.text: Well, I had been just throwing them at the techrot, since they very much do not enjoy being on fire.

g.title: j3955518429
g.text: But it seems Velimir is a decent grill cook.

g.title: j3487538288
g.text: I need to go have *words* with our friend Amir.

g.title: j433409317
g.text: Now that you both had your revenge with that horrific abomination at my expense.

g.title: j1935882166
g.text: The look on your face was incredible.

g.title: j2335336657
g.text: Once he stopped attempting to barbecue the techrot, that is...

g.title: j3298622301
g.text: Now I just need to convince him that trying to barbecue the techrot is a very bad idea...

g.title: j65688008
g.text: Look, I still don't really know what they eat in - whenever you're from - but - I am going to judge you if you start eating *that.*

g.title: j4120583416
g.text: That was roughly the face I made, yes, exactly.
